about.description: GLDY is a Reg D 506(c) gold-backed tokenized security on Base from Streamex (NASDAQ: STEX), offering exposure to vaulted physical gold (~1 oz per token) plus approximately 3.5% APY paid monthly in additional GLDY from institutional gold leasing via Monetary Metals. Tokens are minted directly to verified accredited investors with no unsold-inventory treasury wallet.
about.registryInfo: Streamex Corp., NASDAQ: STEX (formerly BioSig Technologies). GLDY is a gold-backed, yield-bearing tokenized security offered under Reg D 506(c) to verified accredited investors with on-chain whitelisting; gold lease yield generated via Monetary Metals; launched 2026-02-25; an Orca permissioned pool on Solana announced for secondary liquidity (watch for a future Solana mint).
